style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

basis.nativeReconstruction: Useful structural/forms/detail improvements encouraged; no lock on source part count or awkward inboard tread arrangement. No other-object aesthetic criteria read.

visibleSuccessCriteria.outcome: At logical size the unit reads as a stout, usable crafted timber stair entry. Treads/rises/side construction and capped posts have clean purposeful proportions and believable connection/support. Softer bevel transitions give weight and roundness without blobby edges. Rebuilt exterior-half stairs may differ from target/source count, but need a coherent rising path meeting the deck and a clear centered passage.
visibleSuccessCriteria.reject: Flat alternating color rectangles as the only depth cue, floating posts/fasteners, paper-thin disconnected boards, hidden stair continuation painted above deck, collisions, unsupported gaps, accidental silhouette clipping.

visibleSuccessCriteria.outcome: Warm honey/gold walking surfaces, richer reddish/orange brown supporting wood, darker controlled creases; restrained compatible warm metal or dark fixing color where useful. Large planes retain hue/value information, with enough separation to read each step at192x352/128pxcell.
visibleSuccessCriteria.reject: Blown yellow/white cap panels, black dead risers/undersides, muddy orange wash merging all forms, unrelated palette/metal dominance.

visibleSuccessCriteria.outcome: Broad soft highlights on top edges and caps describe the native curvature. Local contact shading can add depth while inner tread corners and undersides remain readable. All4facings share one horizontally symmetric warm-light treatment, with no directional groundshadow.
visibleSuccessCriteria.reject: One-sided global brightening, hard directional key/cast-ground shadow, bright pixel fringe copied from target, clipped hot strips, abrupt normals/faceted seams that look broken rather than stylized.

visibleSuccessCriteria.outcome: Wood has controlled broad native/procedural/packed grain or endgrain where it survives intended size. Purposeful fasteners/joinery/side construction add useful hierarchy and physical clarity, inspired by target round fixings and timber edge treatment. Small details are firmly attached, spaced deliberately and clear of walking path.
visibleSuccessCriteria.reject: Dense hairline noise, decal-like illegible black scribbles, identical obvious texture stamps, tiny random bolt clutter, detached/highlight-only metal dots, grain that changes scale/swims across facings. No mandatory decoration count or shader recipe.

visibleSuccessCriteria.outcome: Inspect enlarged, logical and actual phone/landscape consumer evidence. Silhouette/step edge rhythm reads immediately on light/gray/dark. Contact joins have clean RGB and alpha, without ghost stairs, floor holes, black cracks, red/yellow ringing, clipped geometry or detached detail. Allfacings remain coherent beyond single-view target.
visibleSuccessCriteria.reject: Successful single S render while N/E/W fail, gaps hidden only by dark background, filtering seams, unreported consumer draw-order override, native-render/composite mismatch.
